note: Ratchet-only per-file byte caps for content in the agent boot path. A byte added to coder.md is paid ~40 times on a PAIR story, so growth here is not a style question. size-budget.mjs fails a file over its cap AND fails a cap that was raised above the one on origin/main — caps may only go DOWN. reference/*.md is deliberately exempt: it is on-demand by design and never in the boot path, and this budget must not punish the split that works. Calibrated once against measured sizes after A3/A4. The aspirational post-Track-C targets (build.md <=9500, coder.md <=8000) need behaviour-changing cuts and are gated on a passing bench/ artifact, not on this ratchet.
